title: Sovereign Drug Repurposing: From Veterinary Pharmacology to Human Therapeutics via Anderson Geometry
subtitle: 782 validated checks, 9 crates, 1 binary — the GPS platform rebuild as gen5 proof case
author: ecoPrimals organism (Kevin Mok, Gaia)
abstract: We present a computational pipeline for drug repurposing that begins with veterinary pharmacology (canine atopic dermatitis, Gonzales G1-G6), extends through Anderson localization geometry to human therapeutics, and culminates in a sovereign rebuild of the GPS platform (Bin Chen Lab, Cell 2026). The work spans three springs (healthSpring, wetSpring, neuralSpring), produces 1,021 Rust tests, 97 experiments, 55 Python cross-validation scripts, and a 2.0 MB self-contained binary (tideGlass). The pipeline replaces $210K/year of commercial pharmacometric software with free, open-source, self-verifying code. Every computation is provenance-tracked. Every result is reproducible on consumer hardware.

foundation.title: 1. Foundation: Gonzales G1-G6 (688/688 checks)
foundation.content: Six published papers on canine atopic dermatitis validated across two springs. IL-31 pruritus (G1), oclacitinib JAK selectivity (G2), pruritus time-series (G3), lokivetmab PK (G4), FAD cross-disease (G5), cell-type targets (G6). wetSpring: 359/359 (Exp273-286). neuralSpring: 329/329 (nS-601-605). The Hill dose-response, Anderson barrier heights, three-compartment tissue lattice, and MATRIX drug repurposing scoring are all validated against her published data.

human_extension.title: 2. Human Extensions (927+ Rust tests passing)
human_extension.content: Species-agnostic PK mathematics allows direct transfer: canine oclacitinib → human baricitinib/upadacitinib/abrocitinib (Extension 1, 37/37). One-compartment PK (Ext 2, 30/30). Two-compartment PK (Ext 3, 26/26). mAb cross-species allometry (Ext 4, 19/19). Population PK Monte Carlo 1,000 patients (Ext 5, 27/27). 5-tissue PBPK (Ext 6, 13/13). Michaelis-Menten nonlinear PK (Ext 7). GPU-parallel population PK via barraCuda WGSL shaders. The same code runs canine, human, feline, equine.

tideGlass.title: 3. tideGlass: Sovereign GPS Rebuild (Phase 4)
tideGlass.content: The GPS platform (Bin Chen Lab, Cell 2026) screens 750M compounds for disease-reversing gene expression signatures. 20-year lineage: Lamb 2006 → LINCS → OCTAD → GPS. We rebuilt it sovereign — 9 Rust crates: tideglass-rcl (noise cleaning), tideglass-gps4drug (structure→expression→screening), tideglass-molsearch (MCTS compound optimization), tideglass-screen (reversal scoring), tideglass-octad (cancer atlas), tideglass-nf (neurofibromatosis extension), tideglass-rges (gene expression reversal), tideglass-core, tideglass-bin. 2.0 MB binary. UDS JSON-RPC 2.0 server. 17 IPC methods. No Python 2. No pinned nonsense. No dead environments.

anderson_bridge.title: 4. Anderson Geometry: The Bridge
anderson_bridge.content: Anderson localization — the mathematics of wave propagation in disordered media — provides the geometric framework connecting veterinary and human pharmacology. Drug concentration in tissue is a wave propagating through a disordered lattice. Tissue architecture determines effective dimensionality (d_eff). A drug that localizes in canine dermis (d_eff=2.1) propagates differently in human dermis (d_eff=2.4). The Anderson barrier height from oclacitinib IC50 (nS-601) predicts which drugs cross the tissue-plasma boundary. This is not metaphor — it is validated mathematics. 417+ checks across 4 springs.

drug_discovery_pipeline.title: 5. ADDRC Integration Pipeline
drug_discovery_pipeline.content: The computational front end connects to MSU's Assay Development and Drug Repurposing Core (ADDRC, Room B338 Life Science Building). Anderson-augmented MATRIX scoring identifies candidates. ADDRC screens 35,000 compounds. Gonzales lab validates with iPSC skin models. Ellsworth medicinal chemistry optimizes leads. The pipeline: MATRIX + Anderson → ADDRC HTS → iPSC validation → medicinal chemistry → preclinical. GPU Hill sweep: 8K compounds × 10 concentrations × 6 cytokine targets = 480K evaluations on a single RTX 4070.

one_health.title: 6. One Health: Dogs Are Not Defective Humans
one_health.content: The conventional approach tests human drugs on animal models. We invert this: study canine atopic dermatitis AS canine atopic dermatitis. The dog is not a model for the human — the dog is a source of causal insight into the disease biology. Anderson geometry reveals WHERE the species diverge and WHY. Cross-species allometric scaling transfers parameters. But the causal mechanisms — the reason oclacitinib works in dogs — illuminate the biology in ways that forcing human drugs onto animal models never will. Studying disease where it naturally occurs reveals mechanism. That's the One Health thesis Andrea Gonzales articulated in our June 2026 meeting.

sovereignty.title: 7. Sovereignty: $15K vs $210K/year
sovereignty.content: The pipeline replaces NONMEM ($2K/yr), Monolix ($1.5K/yr), WinNonlin ($3K/yr), and CRO population PK ($50-200K/program) with free, self-verifying Rust code running on consumer hardware. Total hardware cost: ~$15K. Assembled from Newegg and Facebook Marketplace. 11 gates, ~1 TB system RAM, ~248 GB GPU VRAM, 122 TB storage, 10G backbone. No cloud. No queue times. No shared anything. The ecosystem IS the infrastructure. The proof is the sporePrint.
